name: xtb
description: Builds xtb 6.8.0 (GFN-xTB and GFN-FF semiempirical methods; program xtb and libxtb) into /usr/local with GCC, OpenMP and OpenBLAS from the release source archive, which carries its own tblite, dftd4, s-dftd3 and CPCM-X. With the python Feature it also installs the hash-pinned tblite 0.8.0 wheel, whose tblite.ase.TBLite is the ASE calculator that replaced xtb-python.
